title: Debate conduct: charity, Socratic questions and staying in control
thesis: Winning a debate is not the same as winning a person. Apply the principle of charity, ask questions more than you assert, concede what is true, and keep the discussion on the strongest ground.
evidence: Steelmanning and charity. State your opponent's view in a form he would accept before criticising it. It earns trust, prevents straw men, and makes your critique land.

The Socratic method. Ask questions that expose assumptions: "How do you know that?" "What would count as evidence?" "Does that standard apply to your own view?" A person who reaches the problem himself is more convinced than one who is told.
Concede what is true. If the opponent makes a good point (a weak hadith, a debated Quranic variant), concede it and show why it doesn't affect your conclusion. Credibility is your main asset.

Lead with your strongest material. One strong argument well defended beats ten weak ones; weak arguments let the opponent win the exchange and discredit the rest (see the Use with care flags throughout this library).
Control the frame. Begin by agreeing on the question and the standard of evidence. Keep returning to it when the debate drifts.

Adab. The Quran: "Argue with them in the way that is best" (16:125); "Do not argue with the People of the Book except in the best manner" (29:46). Good manners are not weakness; they are part of dawah.

ar_quotes.text: ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَادِلْهُم بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ

practice.q: “You just ask questions; why won't you make your own case?”
practice.a: Questions are how we find out whether a view holds up. But here's my case, numbered so you can tell me which premise you reject: one, two, three. Now, back to my question about your standard of evidence.

sum: Steelman your opponent, ask Socratic questions, concede true points, lead with your strongest arguments, control the frame, and argue "in the way that is best" (16:125).

quran_arabic.16:125: ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِیلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَـٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِی هِیَ أَحۡسَنُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِیلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِینَ
quran_arabic.29:46: ۞ وَلَا تُجَـٰدِلُوۤا۟ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِی هِیَ أَحۡسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِینَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَقُولُوۤا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِیۤ أُنزِلَ إِلَیۡنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَیۡكُمۡ وَإِلَـٰهُنَا وَإِلَـٰهُكُمۡ وَ ٰحِدࣱ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ مُسۡلِمُونَ
